data.name: Tragic Accident
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, once per day as part of a successful attack, you can target your opponent with either inflict critical wounds or poison as a free action. The DC for this ability is %1. You don't have to declare the use of this ability until you know the attack is successful.|10+TL/2+CHA
